_doc: Hand-curated technology and engineered artefacts. Vegapunk's creations, Den Den Mushi types, weapon-tech, and the major political artefacts (Empty Throne, Crown of the World, etc).

tech.name: Pacifista (PX-series)
tech.notes: Cybernetic supersoldiers modelled after Bartholomew Kuma. Equipped with Kuma's Nikyu Nikyu no Mi paw-pad lasers. PX-1 through PX-9 deployed at Sabaody.

tech.name: Seraphim
tech.notes: Vegapunk's child-bodied Special Science Group weapons. Templated on the Seven Warlords with Lunarian DNA. S-Bear (Kuma), S-Hawk (Mihawk), S-Snake (Hancock), S-Shark (Jinbe).

tech.name: Vegaforce-01
tech.notes: Vegapunk-piloted humanoid combat mech. Used in defence of Egghead.

tech.name: Standard Den Den Mushi
tech.notes: Telepathic snail used as a phone. Mimics the speaker's voice and expression.

tech.name: Black Den Den Mushi
tech.notes: Eavesdropping snail — picks up signals from other Den Den Mushi nearby.

tech.name: Golden Den Den Mushi
tech.notes: Triggers a Buster Call. Five Elders + Fleet Admiral authorisation only.

tech.name: Visual Den Den Mushi
tech.notes: Video-feed snail. Used to broadcast Marineford and Vegapunk's final speech worldwide.

tech.name: Mother Flame
tech.notes: Vegapunk's solar-flame device. Demonstrated on Lulusia (vaporised the kingdom). Mass-destruction tier — the Five Elders confiscated all knowledge of it.

tech.name: Empty Throne
tech.notes: The seat at the centre of the World Government. Ostensibly empty — actually occupied by Imu in secret.

tech.name: Crown of the King of the World
tech.notes: Object referenced as the title held by the Pirate King-equivalent on the World Government side. Hinted to be an actual physical relic.

tech.name: Sea Train (Puffing Tom)
tech.notes: Tom's invention. Travels on rails laid across the sea. Connects Water 7 to Enies Lobby, St. Poplar, and other islands.

tech.name: Senbonzakura cannon
tech.notes: Marine fortress-grade cannon at Enies Lobby. Single shot devastates buildings.

tech.name: Punk Records
tech.notes: Vegapunk's in-universe database of all knowledge — the encyclopedia this Codex is named for. Stored on Egghead's central servers.

tech.name: Bubble Coating
tech.notes: Bubble Coral resin applied to ships at Sabaody to enable underwater travel. The only way to descend to Fish-Man Island normally.

tech.name: Klabautermann sense
tech.notes: Not strictly tech — but the spirit of a well-loved ship that gives sailors guidance. Going Merry's was the most prominent in canon.
